# Tiny LFM2-VL Hybrid Loader Fixture

This directory contains deterministic, synthetic GGUF and tokenizer inputs for
the public `candle_vlm::lfm2_vl::load_lfm2_vl_hybrid` contract. It contains no
production checkpoint data.

The files are generated by the existing Rust fixture builders used in
`candle-transformers` MMProj tests and the `lfm2-vl` example tests:

- `text.gguf`: quantized tiny LFM2 text tower derived from
  `../lfm2_vl_tiny/tensors.safetensors`.
- `mmproj-dense.gguf`: dense F32 direct MMProj.
- `mmproj-q8.gguf`: mixed native Q8_0/F32 direct MMProj.
- `tokenizer.json`: 32-token deterministic tokenizer with the complete tiny
  image marker set.

Tests pair these files with the existing split bundle and processor config in
`../lfm2_vl_mmproj_tiny/`. Exact file sizes and SHA-256 values are pinned in
`manifest.json`. GGUF files are binary (`-text`); JSON and Markdown are LF
text at checkout.
